projection.fingerprint: sha256 over canonical ordered binding records, which embed the inventory fingerprint so the binding is provably computed over the exact canonical inventory
projection.inference_rule: deterministic (layer_type, variant) -> host operation-ID lookup; variant-discriminated layer types require an exact variant match; variant-insensitive layer types collapse to a single host operation-ID, matching LayerRegistry init acceptance
projection.input: canonical live instance records enumerated directly from LayerRegistry state, not AgentWorkspace mirrors
projection.state_identity_scope: live structure plus validated init identity and parameter count; current numerical weight/state bytes are not included

purpose: Infer the host operation-ID for every live LayerRegistry instance from the canonical (layer_type, variant) protocol identity. This completes the protocol (layer_type, variant) -> host operation-ID inference deferred by burn-research.layer-registry-inventory.v1, without ranking, selecting, initializing, executing, or mutating anything.

rust_tests: empty registry binds to an empty deterministic non-executing snapshot
live linear/activation/conv instances bind to their exact host operation-IDs
binding fingerprint is anchored to the inventory fingerprint of the same live state
